offset: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * (math.pow(math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180), 0.7))) + variable.w.x * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * variable.h

(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * (math.pow(math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180), 0.7))) + variable.w.y * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * variable.h

(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * (math.pow(math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180), 0.7))) + variable.w.z * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * variable.h
direction: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))
(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))
(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))

size: variable.particle_age < (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur) ? 0 : variable.size * (0.1 + math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180) * 0.1) * (1 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.85)

variable.particle_age < (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur) ? 0 : variable.size * (0.1 + math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180) * 0.1) * (1 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.85)

color.interpolant: variable.tone > 0.75 ? math.clamp(0.78 + (1 - variable.particle_random_2) * 0.22 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.1, 0.78, 1) : math.clamp(variable.particle_random_2 * 0.6 + math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.25 + variable.tone, 0, 0.7)
